title: Free okra seeds
description: Request a free packet of 10 Clemson Spineless okra seeds from Olivia's Garden Foundation, mailed in the US and Canada. No account needed.
summary: Olivia's Garden Foundation mails a free packet of 10 Clemson Spineless okra seeds to anyone in the United States or Canada. Request yours with a short form. No account needed.

heroImage.alt: A kraft seed packet hand-labeled Clemson Spineless okra, with a handful of dark seeds inside, surrounded by three fresh okra pods.

socialImage.alt: Free okra seeds from Olivia's garden, with a hand-labeled Clemson Spineless okra seed packet and fresh pods.

intro: Okra was Olivia's favorite thing to grow. Her family has kept her plants going, and every packet we mail comes from that same line.

items: 10 Clemson Spineless okra seeds, a variety with smooth pods that loves sun and heat.
Free mailing by USPS anywhere in the United States or Canada.
Local pickup instead, if you're near McKinney, Texas.
Plant according to your hardiness zone, straight into the sunniest spot you have. Okra doesn't like being transplanted.
Let a few pods dry on the plant at the end of the season, and you'll have seed for next year.
Share a photo of your patch on the [Okra Project map](/okra) so others can see where Olivia's okra is growing.

faq.question: Are the okra seeds really free?
faq.answer: Yes. The seeds and the mailing are free, and you don't need an account.

faq.question: How are the okra seeds shipped?
faq.answer: By standard USPS mail, so delivery time depends on the mail where you live. We'll email you about your request.

faq.question: Can schools or groups request free okra seeds?
faq.answer: Schools, garden clubs, and other groups should reach out through our [Partner with us](/partners) page rather than the seed request form.

faq.question: Will my address show on the Okra Project map?
faq.answer: No. When we mail your seeds, a "seeds sent" pin shows only your city and the month. Your first name appears only if you choose to show it.
